name: Modeling
overview: Scripture warns against valuing outward beauty or conforming to worldly appearances, emphasizing instead the importance of inner godliness and righteous judgment. The Proverbs passages caution against lust and highlight that true praise belongs to those who fear the Lord rather than those who rely on physical attractiveness. Jeremiah and Romans call believers to reject vanity and worldly conformity by renewing the mind to discern God's perfect will. Jesus teaches that even looking with lust is sinful, underscoring the heart's purity over external appearances.
